name: Sloppy Chori-Joes (Chorizo Sloppy Joes)

ingredients.name: Hot sauce, such as Frank's, to taste

instructions.primary_message: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add onions and peppers and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and well-browned, about 10 minutes. Add chorizo and cook, breaking it up with a potato masher or whisk. Continue cook until meat is cooked through, abut 5 minutes.

Drain excess fat and return pan to heat. Add sugar and tomato sauce and cook, stirring, until reduced to a sauce-like texture. Stir in hot sauce and season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into toasted burger buns, top with avocado and onion, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: chorizo, easy, pork, quick, sandwich, sloppy joe

description: Spicy chorizo sautéd with avocado and poblano peppers makes for a flavor-packed, adult-friendly upgrade to standard sloppy joes while still maintaining the sweet and savory quality that makes the originals so darn delicious. Once you've got the chorizo on hand, this recipe comes together in under 30 minutes.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Sliced avocado, for garnish; Sliced white onion, for garnish

Notes: Store-bought fresh Mexican chorizo can be used in place of the homemade. Remove from casings before using. Store-bought salsa verde can be used in place of homemade.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
